title: After the Apology to Jiyeon
description:
Two months since you apologized to Jiyeon.
She said 'It's fine.'
Today Jiyeon reached out to ask to meet.

choices.result_text:
You met.
The first meeting after an apology — was different.

choices.text: Still a bit awkward. Suggest next time.
choices.result_text:
You said 'Let's meet soon.'
She said 'Sure.'
Awkwardness doesn't go away by avoiding it.

title: Jiyeon's Network
description:
Three months since you started treating Jiyeon as a kind of mentor.
Since then, someone she introduced you to had stayed in touch.
Today they brought a proposal.

choices.result_text:
You heard it.
It had come through Jiyeon.

choices.text: Ask Jiyeon about it first before deciding
choices.result_text:
You asked Jiyeon first.
She replied 'They're trustworthy.'

title: Built-Up Trust
description:
Building trust with Jiyeon had taken a long time.
And today — Jiyeon opened up with something real for the first time.

choices.result_text:
You listened for a long time.
Jiyeon kept talking — as she talked, more came out.
Trust takes a long time to build — and a moment to spend.

You talked it through together.
Jiyeon said 'There aren't many people I can say this to.'

title: When Jiyeon Opened Up
description:
A month since Jiyeon opened up for the first time.
The conversations since have been different.
Today she brought something up on her own again.

choices.result_text:
You listened.
Jiyeon said, 'Talking to you is easy, oppa.'

You were honest too.
When one side opens — the other does too. That's conversation.

title: Jiyeon's Introduction
description:
Two months since you met someone Jiyeon introduced you to.
Today they reached out again.

choices.result_text:
You met again.
The introduction through Jiyeon — had continued beyond Jiyeon.

'Busy these days,' you said.
They understood.

title: After Deflecting the Business Talk
description:
Two months since you brushed off Jiyeon's business pitch.
Today she brought it up again.
This time, directly.

choices.text: Hear it out properly this time
choices.result_text:
You listened.
With actual attention, it was clearer than you'd let it be.

You slid past it again.
Jiyeon's expression shifted for a moment.
She said 'I see.'

title: Directly with Jiyeon's Mother
description:
Two months since you had a direct conversation with Jiyeon's mother.
Today Jiyeon brought it up.
'My mother was saying good things about you, oppa.'

choices.text: "Was she? Please pass on my thanks."
choices.result_text:
Jiyeon smiled.
'I will.'

You received it calmly.
Jiyeon said 'You're so unfazed.'

title: Gratitude Returned
description:
What you'd done for Jiyeon — came back in an unexpected way.
Today Jiyeon did something for you first.

choices.result_text:
You received it gratefully.
The timing of when giving comes back — can't be predicted.

'You didn't need to do this,' you said.
Jiyeon said 'I wanted to.'

title: The Deepened Connection
description:
Two months since you felt the bond with Daeun had deepened.
Today Daeun called, voice heavy.
"Minjun-ssi. I'm having a rough time right now."

choices.text: "I can come out now. Where are you?"
choices.result_text:
You went.
Daeun said 'You didn't have to come out.'
'I did,' you said.

You listened on the phone.
An hour passed.
At the end Daeun said 'Thank you.'

title: The Second Time
description:
A month since you met Daeun alone for the second time.
Today Daeun proposed a third.

choices.result_text:
You said 'Sure.' right away.
A third one became real.

choices.text: "Let me check my schedule and get back to you."
choices.result_text:
You checked.
You were free.
You replied.

title: Being Honest with Daeun
description:
Two months since you told Daeun something honestly.
It wasn't easy to say.
Today Daeun looked back on that day.

choices.result_text: Daeun said 'I know. That's what made it good.'

choices.text: "I just felt like I had to."
choices.result_text:
'I felt like I should say it,' you said.
Daeun replied 'Not many people are like that.'
